ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

2. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Burning crop residue every week

3. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. newton (N)

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Water its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water its resources.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.

8. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Decomposers only
   D. Producers

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Safety when handling? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Safety when handling.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Safety when handling.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Safety when handling.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Safety when handling.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transporting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Transporting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transporting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transporting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transporting.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Re-using water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Conservation environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Weather its resources and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

2. C — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

3. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

4. D — newton (N)
